title: Design a portable agent memory module

messages.content: Build a memory module that is not tied to one agent platform.

结论：The filesystem object store is the source of truth.
流程：Archive the sanitized session, extract structured objects, then rebuild derived indexes.
完成：The minimal dual-ledger design was accepted.

memory_candidates.title: Canonical storage invariant
memory_candidates.content: Memory objects stored in the workspace are canonical; SQLite and vector databases are rebuildable indexes.
memory_candidates.summary: Filesystem objects are canonical and indexes are derived.

memory_candidates.title: Session archiving loop
memory_candidates.content: Sanitize the session, classify it, preserve evidence, extract memory objects, update both ledgers, then validate recall.
